_note: Rogue (2024). Base class + Thief are SRD 5.2 (CC-BY); Assassin / Arcane Trickster / Soulknife are mechanics + original descriptions.

classes.name: Rogue

weapons: Martial weapons with Finesse or Light

startingEquipment: Leather Armor, 2 Daggers, Shortsword, Shortbow, 20 Arrows, Quiver, Thieves' Tools, Burglar's Pack, 8 GP
classes.flavor: A precise, deadly specialist who strikes where it hurts, dances out of danger, and turns skills into an art — the party's scout, striker, and problem-solver.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Choose two of your skill proficiencies; your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make with them. You choose two more at level 6.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Once per turn you can deal extra damage (shown on the table, starting at 1d6) to one creature you hit with a Finesse or Ranged weapon, if you have Advantage on the attack — or if an ally is within 5 feet of the target and you don't have Disadvantage. The extra damage matches the weapon's type.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.description: You know Thieves' Cant, a secret mix of dialect, jargon, and hand signs, plus a set of covert marks and messages.

features.name: Weapon Mastery
features.description: You can use the Mastery property of two kinds of weapon you're proficient with. You can change your choices after a Long Rest.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: On your turn you can take a Bonus Action to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

features.name: Steady Aim
features.description: As a Bonus Action you give yourself Advantage on your next attack this turn, provided you haven't moved. Your Speed is 0 until the end of the turn.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two by 1 (max 20), or take a feat. Repeats at 8th, 10th, 12th, and 16th level.

features.name: Cunning Strike
features.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage you can forgo some of its dice to add an effect: Poison (Poisoned condition), Trip (knock Prone), or Withdraw (move without provoking). Each effect costs a set number of Sneak Attack dice.

features.name: Uncanny Dodge
features.description: When an attacker you can see hits you, you can use a Reaction to halve the attack's damage against you.

features.name: Evasion
features.description: When you make a Dexterity save to take half damage, you instead take no damage on a success and only half on a failure. You can't use it while Incapacitated.

features.name: Reliable Talent
features.description: Whenever you make an ability check with a skill or tool you're proficient in, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

features.name: Improved Cunning Strike
features.description: You can apply two different Cunning Strike effects with a single Sneak Attack (paying the die cost of each).

features.name: Devious Strikes
features.description: You gain three more Cunning Strike options: Daze, Knock Out, and Obscure.

features.name: Slippery Mind
features.description: You gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma saving throws.

features.name: Elusive
features.description: No attack roll can have Advantage against you while you aren't Incapacitated.

features.name: Epic Boon
features.description: You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat you qualify for. Boon of Dimensional Travel is a fitting choice.

features.name: Stroke of Luck
features.description: Once per Short or Long Rest, you can turn a missed attack into a hit, or a failed ability check into a success — treat the d20 as a 20.

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.flavor: A nimble burglar and treasure-hunter, quick of hand and quick to exploit any magic item you can lay hands on.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: You can use your Cunning Action Bonus Action to make a Sleight of Hand check, use Thieves' Tools to disarm a trap or open a lock, or take the Utilize action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.description: You gain a Climb Speed equal to your Speed, and your running jump distance is measured using your Dexterity instead of your Strength.

features.name: Supreme Sneak
features.description: You have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks if you move no more than half your Speed on the same turn, and you can make a Stealth check as part of your Cunning Action Hide.

features.name: Use Magic Device
features.description: You can attune to up to four magic items at once, can use any magic item's activated properties even if you don't meet its requirements, and can wring extra charges from a wand or staff (risking a mishap).

features.name: Thief's Reflexes
features.description: You can take two turns during the first round of any combat — one at your Initiative and one at your Initiative minus 10.

subclasses.name: Assassin
subclasses.flavor: A cold, methodical killer who strikes first and hardest, wears any face, and coats blades in death.

features.name: Assassinate
features.description: You have Advantage on attacks against any creature that hasn't taken a turn yet in combat, and you always have Initiative Advantage. On your first turn, your Sneak Attack deals extra damage (dice equal to your Rogue level) to any creature you Surprise or that hasn't acted.

features.name: Assassin's Tools
features.description: You gain a Disguise Kit, a Poisoner's Kit, and proficiency with both.

features.name: Infiltration Expertise
features.description: As a Study action you can create or maintain a false identity, and you can flawlessly mimic the speech, writing, and behavior of another person you've studied.

features.name: Envenom Weapons
features.description: When you use the Poison option of Cunning Strike, the target takes extra Poison damage (your Rogue level) and its Poisoned condition is harder to shake.

features.name: Death Strike
features.description: When you hit a Surprised creature with an attack, it must make a Constitution save (DC 8 + Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus) or take double damage from the attack.

subclasses.name: Arcane Trickster
subclasses.flavor: A spell-thief who laces stealth and larceny with enchantment and illusion — a phantom hand, a nudge to the mind, a stolen spell.

features.name: Spellcasting
features.description: You learn cantrips and spells from the Wizard list (mostly Enchantment and Illusion), casting with Intelligence as a one-third caster.

features.name: Mage Hand Legerdemain
features.description: You know Mage Hand and can cast it invisibly, and use it to perform Sleight of Hand, pick locks, and disarm traps at a distance.

features.name: Magical Ambush
features.description: If you're Hidden from a creature when you cast a spell on it, it has Disadvantage on any saving throw against that spell.

features.name: Versatile Trickster
features.description: You can use Mage Hand as a Bonus Action to distract a creature within 5 feet of the hand, giving you Advantage on attack rolls against it until the end of the turn.

features.name: Spell Thief
features.description: When a creature casts a spell that targets you, you can use a Reaction to force a save; on a failure you negate the spell and steal knowledge of it for 8 hours. Once per Long Rest.

subclasses.name: Soulknife
subclasses.flavor: A psionic assassin who manifests blades of pure mind-force, striking from range and slipping through the world unseen.

features.name: Psionic Power
features.description: You have a pool of Psionic Energy Dice (starting as d6s). You can manifest Psychic Blades — thrown or melee attacks of psychic force that carry your Sneak Attack — and add a Psionic Energy Die to certain ability checks. The dice grow larger as you level and refresh on rests.

features.name: Soul Blades
features.description: You gain Homing Strikes (spend a die to turn a missed Psychic Blade attack into a hit) and Psychic Teleportation (throw a blade to teleport up to 10 feet times the die rolled).

features.name: Psychic Veil
features.description: As a Magic action you can turn Invisible for 1 hour or until you attack or force a save. Once per Long Rest, or by spending a Psionic Energy Die.

features.name: Rend Mind
features.description: When you deal Sneak Attack damage with your Psychic Blades, you can force the target to make a Wisdom save or be Stunned for 1 minute (repeating the save each turn). Once per Long Rest, or by spending three Psionic Energy Dice.
